hooks.text: 从底盘到引擎、武器和装甲自由拼装末日战车，并统一性能与外观风格
hooks.excerpt: Build your own doomsday war machine! The Vehicle Assembly system is now live! From chassis and frame to engines, weapons, and armor modules — mix and match parts freely to craft your custom combat vehicle from the ground up. Build a high-speed assault rig, a heavy firepower beast, or a bizarre machine fueled by pure imagination — it’s all in your hands. Assemble, modify, upgrade — you’re in full control. Performance, looks, and tactical style all come together to define your war machine.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 主动规划怪物路线，让爆炸兽、隐形刺客和飞行士兵进入专用陷阱杀阵
hooks.excerpt: Tower Defense-style Traps Strategically route monsters through a brutal crucible of traps designed to slaughter explosive beasts, invisible assassins, flying soldiers, and other catastrophically powerful invaders.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用压力板、红外传感器和完整电路搭建自动防御系统
hooks.excerpt: Logical Systems and Circuits Use monitoring devices such as pressure plates and infrared sensors along with complete circuits to construct automated defense systems.
